senses.definition_en: Used to connect two contrasting statements or ideas; but, nevertheless.
senses.definition_ar: تُستخدم للربط بين فكرتين أو جملتين متناقضتين بمعنى 'لكن' أو 'مع ذلك'.
examples: It was a strange yet beautiful song.
The path was dark, yet I found my way.
He has a good job, and yet he never seems to have any money.
